propositions: A class may reference an unreachable model (downed local endpoint, throttled provider) with no fallback mechanism, causing the gate to fail outright
The fallback array from schema should construct pydantic-ai FallbackModel per class, with fallback entries as inline model configs carrying endpoint, provider, and model
The fallback_on predicate must be narrowed to errors where provider switching helps (RETRY_NOW, WAIT_AND_RETRY, CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL) and exclude credential/input errors that fallback would mask
Capabilities, cache settings and tool guards must be computed from the resolved candidate list (primary + all fallbacks) with the intersection held by every candidate before FallbackModel wraps them
The ran_model field must be read from ModelResponse.model_name to attest which model actually answered, never from FallbackModel.model_name which yields a synthetic combined string

All sub-model clients must be registered on a single ProviderSession and closed exactly once on teardown, with pydantic-ai's providers entered/exited via async context manager and rebar-created transports managed by the session's closeables
